profiles.name: Aquakinetcist

evidence.section: Aquatic Focus / Basis Aquakinesis / Call of the Deep / Ocean’s Caress
evidence.reason: The archetype’s Aquatic Focus / Basis Aquakinesis / Call of the Deep / Ocean’s Caress package materially changes wilderness affinity from the Kineticist baseline.
